content.description:
US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are up ahead of Friday's market close, a shortened trading day that is also the final session of November. While the AI trade has taken a step back in recent weeks, it has been a theme that's driven markets throughout 2025.

Bogart Wealth CIO Aleks Spencer joins Jared Blikre to discuss the trends he is seeing across other industries and the US government's investments and strategic partnerships to better compete with China.
